title: ctenitis nephrodioides
intro: Ctenitis nephrodioides, commonly known as the Nephrolepis-like fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in China, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis nephrodioides include its ability to promote cardiovascular health, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
